items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: I played with old Paul Beaulieu several times.

ctx.x: Any of them go, I can play with them. I wonder some of the dance bands that you've played with in New Orleans here, can you remember some of the musicians that you've played dances with?
I played with old Paul Beaulieu several times. We played a concert with Alphonse Picoult.
By the way, do you know where Beaulieu lives?
